summary.description: Delivery attempts and API calls in one line, e.g. `← slack chat.postMessage` and `200`.

busy.description: A call from the agent is in flight, a delivery is in flight or about to be retried, or a stream is open.

quietForMs.description: Milliseconds since the last event in the session. 0 while busy.

open.description: What is still open, in words: deliveries in flight or about to be retried, streams never stopped.

socketConnections.description: How many Socket Mode connections the app holds open. 0 when it receives over HTTP.

token.description: A real person's user token (`xoxp-`) in the live workspace. Read from CHANNELSTACK_SLACK_USER_<NAME>_TOKEN when left out.

browser.description: A saved browser session, for the actions only Slack's client does (click, Stop).

open.description: False once it was submitted or closed.

errors.description: What the app said is wrong after a submission, by the label of the input.

text.description: The transcript as plain text, one entry per line.

files.description: The names of the files shared with the message.

alsoInChannel.description: A reply that was also sent to the channel.

after.description: How long to wait before the retry. Slack's first retry comes after about 3 seconds.

delay.description: For latency: how long each call takes longer.

after.description: For drop_socket: how long until the connection drops. Default: now.

name.description: The login: what an author is matched by.

author.description: Absent when the commit's author is nobody on GitHub.

actions.description: The identifiers of the buttons the App put on the run.

text.description: The transcript as plain text, one entry per line.

body.description: As a person reads it: a mention is `@name`.

text.description: The transcript as plain text, one entry per line.

token.description: The internal integration token (`ntn_…`), as `channelstack env` prints it.

webhookSecret.description: The subscription's verification token: what webhooks are signed with.

content.description: Markdown, or Notion block objects as the API takes them. SDKs also take a fixture file (`{ path }`).

delay.description: How long an edit waits for others to be sent with it.

text.description: As a person reads it: a mention is `@Name`.

anchor.description: The text of the block it is anchored to; none for the page.

content.description: Markdown, or Notion block objects as the API takes them. SDKs also take a fixture file (`{ path }`).
